Old clock tower collapses at Kozhikode railway station, no injuries reported

A century-old clock tower at Kozhikode railway station partially collapsed onto a platform. Fortunately, no injuries were reported as the structure gave way when people were not directly underneath it. The incident occurred despite people being present on the platform at the time.
